prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: high-resolution photographic key visual for an immersive digital material sculpture. Output a single full-bleed 16:9 landscape image, ideally 2560 by 1440 or higher, without any letters, labels, graphics, UI or border.
Primary request: an extreme close view of genuinely MOLTEN ROCK while its luminous interior is being pulled into two thick slowly folding viscous lobes. This is not a solid rock with cracks: it is a heavy half-liquid mass, with a continuous stretched dark-red skin wrapping around a thick incandescent fold. Think extremely viscous melted black glass carrying its enormous weight under gravity, a quiet arrested ooze, rounded swollen shoulders, a hot fold curling over itself at center-right. Large flowing forms rather than many little crust tiles.
Composition: panoramic close camera, low grazing three-quarter angle. The massive molten fold fills the right two thirds, approaching monumental sculpture scale, cropped beyond the frame. One restrained long red-orange crease along the folded inner lip exposes a near-white hot sliver. Top and left fade into rich volcanic-black surroundings. The lower-left quarter should naturally stay very dark, almost silent, with broad smooth shadow for later typography; do not render typography. No horizon or landscape.
Material and light: 78-85 percent of the image is charcoal/obsidian-black/dark burgundy, but shadow carries exquisite tactile detail. A surface that feels thick, glossy in tiny grazing areas, stretched and fluid; a very thin blackening skin, not a network of dry cracks. The exposed hot inner fold glows internally from deep oxblood red to ember orange with a tiny yellow-white center, casting short-range warm light only on adjacent folds. Subtle neutral side light defines the dense black shoulders. Pin-sharp real geological macro photography, controlled high dynamic range, museum-grade large format still life, black mineral realism.
Constraints: no flames, no eruptions, no smoke, no sparks, no particles, no landscapes, no planet, no stars, no red background, no neon bloom, no web of glowing cracks, no rocks floating, no waterlike splash, no thin liquid ribbons, no game VFX, no lava-shader-demo texture, no illustration or fantasy. A physically convincing thick fluid, dark outside and dangerously hot inside.
